# Test Fixtures

## sample_ride.fit

**100% synthetic** — generated by `make_sample_fit.py`. Contains no athlete
data: no GPS, no real timestamps (an arbitrary synthetic FIT epoch offset),
a synthetic 180-239W power ramp, and fixed HR/cadence. Safe to commit to a
public repository. Regenerate with `py -3 tests/fixtures/make_sample_fit.py`.
Used by `tests/test_fit_ingest.py::TestParseFitSmoke`.
